parameters.jsCode:
const visitData = $json;
const recordId = `MR-${Date.now()}`;
const visitDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

// Extract and format medical record data
const medicalRecord = {
  recordId: recordId,
  appointmentId: visitData.appointmentId || visitData.id || 'N/A',
  petId: visitData['Pet ID'] || visitData.petId || `PET-${Date.now()}`,
  petName: visitData['Pet Name'] || 'N/A',
  petBreed: visitData['Pet Breed'] || 'N/A',
  petAge: visitData['Pet Age'] || 'N/A',
  clientId: visitData['Customer ID'] || visitData.clientId || `CLIENT-${Date.now()}`,
  clientName: visitData['Customer Name'] || 'N/A',
  clientEmail: visitData['Customer Email'] || 'N/A',
  clientPhone: visitData['Customer Phone'] || 'N/A',
  visitDate: visitDate,
  visitTime: visitData['Time'] || new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true }),
  serviceType: visitData['Service'] || 'General Consultation',
  veterinarian: visitData['Assigned Veterinarian'] || '{{DEFAULT_VETERINARIAN}}',
  chiefComplaint: visitData['Chief Complaint'] || visitData['Notes'] || 'Routine check-up',
  clinicalFindings: visitData['Clinical Findings'] || 'To be updated by veterinarian',
  diagnosis: visitData['Diagnosis'] || 'Pending clinical assessment',
  treatment: visitData['Treatment'] || 'As per clinical recommendation',
  medications: visitData['Medications'] || 'None prescribed',
  followUpNotes: visitData['Follow-up Notes'] || 'Routine follow-up as needed',
  vitalSigns: {
    weight: visitData['Weight'] || 'Not recorded',
    temperature: visitData['Temperature'] || 'Not recorded',
    heartRate: visitData['Heart Rate'] || 'Not recorded',
    respiratoryRate: visitData['Respiratory Rate'] || 'Not recorded'
  },
  visitStatus: 'Complete',
  recordStatus: visitData['Staff Notes'] === 'Complete' ? 'Finalized' : 'Pending Documentation',
  createdBy: visitData['Staff ID'] || 'System',
  createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  clinicLocation: '{{CLINIC_NAME}}',
  invoiceAmount: visitData['Invoice Amount'] || '0.00',
  insuranceInfo: visitData['Insurance'] || 'None',
  emergencyContact: visitData['Emergency Contact'] || visitData['Customer Phone'],
  specialInstructions: visitData['Special Instructions'] || 'None'
};

return {
  json: medicalRecord
};

parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Medical Records Management (PET WF6)

**🎯 Purpose:** Ensure all patient data and staff notes are complete and medical records are updated

**🚀 Features:**
• **Data Completeness Checks:** Validates pet history forms and staff notes
• **Smart Reminders:** SMS to clients for incomplete forms, email to staff for missing notes
• **Medical Records Hub:** Automated updates to central medical records database
• **Workflow Orchestration:** Seamless integration with visit completion workflow

**⚡ Workflow Trigger:**
• **Post-Visit Trigger:** Activated by PET WF3 (Visit Completion Orchestrator)

**📊 Integration Points:**
• Medical Records Hub: {{MEDICAL_RECORDS_SHEET_ID}}
• Client Communication: SMS via {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}}
• Staff Communication: Email via {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}
• Form Collection: {{PET_HISTORY_FORM_URL}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Wait Time: 1 hour for staff note completion
• Reminder Logic: Conditional based on completion status
• Record Format: Structured medical data with timestamps
